name: Marukai
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai holds a remote Horde beachhead against the Wrathtail naga. The Darkspear jungle troll coordinates efforts to drive the naga back along Ashenvale's foggy northwest coast.

sections.title: Holding the Strand
sections.body: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai works to keep the encampment from being overwhelmed. The outpost sits on the northern edge of the Zoram Strand, surrounded by ancient ruins, hostile night elf territory, and the restless sea. Wrathtail naga emerge in force from the waters and ancient elven ruins to claim the shoreline. Marukai directs Horde champions to push them back into the tide and collect their heads, keeping the outpost a viable coastal stronghold.

faq.answer: Marukai is a jungle troll defending Zoram'gar Outpost, the Horde's isolated coastal encampment on Ashenvale's northwestern shore.

faq.q: Why is Marukai fighting the naga?
faq.answer: Wrathtail naga have infested the nearby Zoram Strand and surrounding ruins. To secure the outpost's borders and ensure Horde survival on the coast, Marukai hires adventurers to hunt them directly and thin their numbers.
Marukai stands with her kin at Zoram'gar Outpost, at the mouth of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale, just south of the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps.

angles.text: In night elf territory, Marukai anchors one of the Horde's most precarious coastal camps. She relies on allied champions to keep the local naga from overrunning their position.
Far from the warm echoes of Sen'jin Village, Marukai shows the Darkspear tribe's resilience as they carve out fortified footholds for the Horde across Kalimdor.
